parse_init_file: parse a Python __init__.py file to extract _import_structure and TYPE_CHECKING objects per backend
find_backend_in_line: find backend names like is_xxx_available in a given line of init code
analyze_import_differences: analyze differences between _import_structure and TYPE_CHECKING objects and report duplicates or mismatches
check_all_inits: check all __init__.py files in the transformers repo for import structure consistency
check_submodules_registered: check that all transformers submodules are properly registered in the main init _import_structure
